summary.zh: 本次更新让常开桌面端能主动感知新版本，并把更新入口收敛为清晰、安静的检查与提示流程。
summary.en: This update lets long-running desktop apps discover new releases automatically and streamlines updates into a clear, quiet check-and-notify flow.

highlights.zh: 桌面端会在后台定期检查新版本；发现更新后，无需重启应用即可在左上角显示更新提示。
highlights.en: The desktop app now checks for releases in the background and shows an update indicator in the title bar without requiring a restart.

highlights.zh: “关于与诊断”页现在只保留“检查更新”操作；发现新版本后的详情、下载与安装统一从左上角提示进入。
highlights.en: The About & Diagnostics page now offers one Check for updates action; update details, downloads, and installation are accessed from the title-bar indicator after an update is found.

highlights.zh: 修复应用服务重启后可能漏掉更新提示的问题，并确保后台检查失败时不会隐藏已经发现的更新。
highlights.en: Fixed missed update notifications after an app-service restart and ensured failed background checks do not hide an update that was already found.
